title: Crosstalk between Heart Failure and Cognitive Impairment via hsa-miR-933/RELB/CCL21 Pathway.
authors: Feng, Wenxiao; Yang, Jie; Song, Wenchao; Xue, Yitao
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学分析心力衰竭与认知障碍间的miRNA-TF-mRNA调控轴，属于疾病关联的转录组统计与通路富集，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The association between heart failure (HF) and cognitive impairment has received increasing attention from scholars and researchers in recent years. However, no systematic studies have been carried out yet focused on the crosstalk between heart failure and cognitive impairment via miRNAs. METHODS: GSE104150, GSE53473, GSE120584, and GSE116250 with RNA-seq data and clinical data were downloaded from the GSE database. All data were statistically analysed using R software to detect DE-miRNAs and DE-mRNAs associated with both HF and cognitive impairment. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks were mapped, and a logistic regression model for cognitive impairment prediction was developed. Furthermore, the TTRUST database and miRWalk were used to map miRNA-transcription factor (TF) and messenger RNA (mRNA) regulatory pathways. Finally, core TFs were enriched for analysis. RESULTS: Differentially enriched DE-miRNAs and DE-mRNAs both present in HF and cognitive impairment were determined. A logistic regression model established based on DE-miRNAs was validated to have a strong performance in cognitive impairment prediction. The core miRNA-TF-mRNA pathway was formed by mapping the PPI networks associated with the two diseases. Further GSEA was performed with V-rel reticuloendotheliosis viral oncogene homolog B (RELB) as the core TF, and the retinol metabolism and gap junction pathways were analysed. CONCLUSIONS: This study was the first attempt to predict the crosstalk and examine underlying mechanisms between HF and cognitive impairment applying bioinformatics. The findings suggested a potential hsa-miR-933/RELB/CCL21 regulatory axis correlated with HF and neurological disorders (or cognitive impairment), according to PPI networks.
abstract_zh: 背景：近年来，心力衰竭（heart failure, HF）与认知障碍之间的关联日益受到学者和研究者的关注。然而，目前尚无系统研究聚焦于通过miRNAs探讨心力衰竭与认知障碍之间的相互作用。方法：从GSE数据库下载GSE104150、GSE53473、GSE120584和GSE116250的RNA-seq数据及临床数据。使用R软件对所有数据进行统计分析，以检测与HF和认知障碍均相关的DE-miRNAs和DE-mRNAs。绘制蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（protein-protein interaction, PPI）网络，并开发用于认知障碍预测的逻辑回归模型。此外，利用TTRUST数据库和miRWalk绘制miRNA-转录因子（transcription factor, TF）和信使RNA（messenger RNA, mRNA）调控通路。最后，对核心转录因子进行富集分析。结果：确定了在HF和认知障碍中均存在的差异富集DE-miRNAs和DE-mRNAs。基于DE-miRNAs建立的逻辑回归模型经验证在认知障碍预测中表现出较强性能。通过绘制与两种疾病相关的PPI网络，形成了核心miRNA-TF-mRNA通路。进一步以V-rel网状内皮增生病毒癌基因同源物B（RELB）作为核心转录因子进行GSEA分析，并分析了视黄醇代谢和间隙连接通路。结论：本研究首次尝试应用生物信息学方法预测HF与认知障碍之间的相互作用并探讨其潜在机制。根据PPI网络，研究结果提示存在一个与HF和神经疾病（或认知障碍）相关的潜在hsa-miR-933/RELB/CCL21调控轴。
